items.lede: JustWatch, the popular streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service, offering free, ad-supported movies and shows alongside a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier and movie rentals.
items.title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself

items.lede: A lifetime ad-free subscription is available.
items.title: JustWatch, which tackles streaming fragmentation, launches own streaming service
